ac2_amended_pattern_actually_discriminat.description: AC2 was amended on this seat's row (AMENDMENT 1 @289391dfbf) after the original expect '^[0-9]+$' proved ungradeable. An amended criterion earns no trust from being new, so the replacement pattern was exercised against inputs it must REFUSE, not only against the one it must accept.
ac2_amended_pattern_actually_discriminat.expected_landed: the artifact's first BRAND line matches; a file carrying neither shape does not match; a BRAND line whose digest is 63 hex characters does not match
ac2_amended_pattern_actually_discriminat.expected_not_landed: a match on either negative input, which would mean the pattern accepts ill-formed output and the criterion is still not deciding anything
ac2_amended_pattern_actually_discriminat.observed: artifact -> matches on the Opal-Capital-Logo line. A scratch file of UNIT=/ROOT=/total lines -> no match. A scratch BRAND line with a 63-hex digest -> no match, so the {64} quantifier bites. The original defect is therefore closed in both directions: the evidence is a real line rather than a bare integer, and a zero-file directory can no longer read PASS as an inventory -- it would have to match BRAND-DIR-ABSENT, which is the order's stated finding branch and is now distinguishable in the evidence itself.
